core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Rehman corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْمَان (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحْمَان (Raḥmān)). Its core sense is rehman; the most merciful. Rehman is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحْمَان (Raḥmān) 'the Most Merciful', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Benevolent, Merciful, Kind' is broadly consistent. Same name as rahman.

urdu.name: رحمان
urdu.long_meaning: Rehman (رحمان) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم رحمان، بے حد مہربان ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: رحمان
persian.long_meaning: Rehman (رحمان) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رحمان، بخشنده است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: रहमान
hindi.long_meaning: Rehman (रहमान) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ रहमान, दयालु है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: رحمان
pashto.long_meaning: Rehman (رحمان) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې رحمان، مهربان ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: رَحْمَان
arabic.long_meaning: Rehman (رَحْمَان) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الرَّحْمَان. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

name_story.story: Rehman can be understood through the Arabic form رَحْمَان, whose central sense is rehman; the most merciful. Rehman is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحْمَان (Raḥmān) 'the Most Merciful', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Benevolent, Merciful, Kind' is broadly consistent. Same name as rahman.

faq.a: Rehman is associated with the Arabic form رَحْمَان, whose core sense is rehman; the most merciful.

faq.q: What is the origin of Rehman?
faq.a: Rehman is associated with Arabic. Rehman is a spelling variant of Arabic رَحْمَان (Raḥmān) 'the Most Merciful', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Benevolent, Merciful, Kind' is broadly consistent. Same name as rahman.
Yes — the underlying form رَحْمَان is Arabic.
Rehman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Rehman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Rehman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Rehman is rendered رحمان and carries the sense رحمان، بے حد مہربان.

faq.q: What does Rehman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Rehman is rendered رحمان and carries the sense رحمان، بخشنده.
A romanized syllable approximation is reh-man. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Rehman?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Rehman, rehman. Script forms are رحمان, رَحْمَان, रहमान.

faq.q: Is Rehman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
